meta.name: Where's Wanda?
meta.description: After the Klatts' daughter goes missing, they take matters into their own hands and hatch a wild plan: Spy on the neighborhood. As they make their way into small-time espionage, shocking secrets come to light one by one.

videos.title: The Klatts
videos.overview: When their missing daughter's shirt turns up in a neighborhood donation bin, Carlotta and Dedo come up with a wild idea to find her.

videos.title: The Hessels
videos.overview: Dedo clumsily breaks into the home of a teacher from Wanda's school. Ole discovers what his parents are doing and makes a suggestion.

videos.title: The Roths
videos.overview: After a session at her therapist's house, Carlotta spots something suspicious. Detective Rauch gets a troubling update on the case.

videos.title: The Vinsons
videos.overview: Carlotta forms a bond with Lucie Vinson, Wanda's schoolmate. Dedo and Ole stumble upon a new clue.

videos.title: The Novaks
videos.overview: Dedo's secret is exposed. Ole attends Games World and meets Chris, who gives him hopeful news about Wanda.

videos.title: The Küchlers
videos.overview: Carlotta and Dedo find themselves in a scary situation, and it forces them to confront their problems.

videos.title: The King
videos.overview: The Klatts forge a plan to cover their tracks after Detective Rauch suspects the homes in their neighborhood are bugged.

videos.title: Wandafest
videos.overview: With the festival underway, the Klatts set out on their mission—and make a shocking discovery.

videos.title: Monday
videos.overview: A year later and the Klatts are thriving...until a shocking death changes everything.

videos.title: Tuesday
videos.overview: The Klatts dive back into amateur detective mode and investigate the owner of a nail salon.

videos.title: Wednesday
videos.overview: Carlotta sets up a honey trap for the man with an eye patch—and learns something she didn't expect.

videos.title: Thursday
videos.overview: A search of Katarina's office points the Klatts toward a new suspect: an angry former employee.

videos.title: Friday
videos.overview: The town gathers for Katarina's memorial service. Dedo and Rüdiger uncover G.B.'s mysterious activities.

videos.title: Friday Night
videos.overview: Wanda confronts her trauma. Dedo opens up to his mother. Carlotta's secret meeting takes a turn.

videos.title: Saturday
videos.overview: To help her mother, Wanda must do the impossible. Dedo takes a stand, with dire consequences.
